targets.root_workflow: Before an exact edit, read one current uncompressed target span, apply the smallest edit that preserves terminal-newline state, do not verify after success, and reread/retry only on stale source, ambiguity, or failure.

arms.focus: Replace the target with one concise instruction: use compact reads only for broad discovery; when an edit is likely, read the exact uncompressed span once, reuse it for the edit, preserve terminal-newline state, and reread only after stale-source or edit failure.

Replace the target with one concise exact-edit transaction: one current uncompressed span read, one minimum edit preserving terminal-newline state, no verification after exact success, and reread/retry only for stale source, ambiguity, or failure.

Replace the target with one concise dependency-aware edit instruction: batch known-independent exact reads, use each result once, preserve terminal-newline state, perform one derived mutation, and stop after exact success unless stale or ambiguous.

Replace the target with one concise outcome instruction: for an edit, read the exact current span once, preserve exact bytes and terminal-newline state, make the minimum mutation, and stop after exact success unless ambiguity, stale source, or failure is reported.
